indications_and_usage: Use for relief of minor skin irritations due to: insect bites minor cuts minor scrapes
when_using: When using this product avoid contact with the eyes
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms persist for more than 7 days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions apply as often as needed
